title: ROE Policy Compiler and Safety Explainer
goal: Compile scope, depth, authorization, exploitation tier, credential rules, rate limits, target allowlists, denylist exclusions, and kill-switch state into machine-checkable policy decisions with plain-language explanations for operators and AI planning.
scope: ROE enforcement, safety explanation, and policy decisions.
generation_reason: AegisPT should make safety constraints explicit and explainable so AI can plan confidently without tripping over vague security boundaries.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: The compiler may only tighten or explain policy decisions; it must not weaken scope, ROE, approval, credential, or kill-switch gates.

success_criteria: Policy decisions return allow, deny, approval_required, wait_for_prerequisite, and kill_switch_blocked states.
Each decision includes source policy IDs, target normalization, affected runner/action, and an operator-readable explanation.
AI planner and UI can reuse the same policy decision payload.

acceptance_criteria: Out-of-scope targets are denied with a clear explanation.
Controlled proof requiring higher tier returns approval_required unless the ROE already confirms that tier.
Kill-switch state blocks planning and dispatch explanations.

after_completion: Promote exactly one next task into NEXT_TASK.md.
